name: expense-webapp
description: The single-page app both Employees and Managers use: an employee uploads a receipt, reviews the agent's extracted fields, and submits the expense and tracks its status; a manager reviews and decides the expenses of the people who report to them. Holds no business logic of its own — every read and write goes through expense-api or the extraction agent.

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Submits and lists expenses, and carries manager decisions.

dependencies.name: receipt-extraction-agent
dependencies.description: Extracts vendor/date/amount/category from an uploaded receipt photo before submission.
